desc: The DAKA Range Bag line is designed and built to be the last range bag you'll ever need. Constructed from proprietary DAKA Grit (600D TPU-coated nylon) and DAKA Dura (840D TPU-coated nylon)fabrics that include RF-welded seams and dual YKK Aquaguard zippers, the DAKA Range Bag is able to handle the weather, dirt, and rough treatment of your next range trip. To protect all your gear, the DAKA Range Bag is built upon a structured Hypalon bottom that also includes a layer of compressed foam for extra durability and support. For easy carrying, there are stowable sling mounting plates on each side of the bag to attach a QD, Paraclip, MASH Hook, or other similar connecting device to support carrying the bag with a sling over theshoulder when the Range Bag is loaded withgear. The Range Bag also includes a pair of handles attached with a die-cut DAKA patch for extra strength when the bag is full of equipment. There's also an exterior-mounted, RF-welded DAKA ID card slot and a dot matrix grid for keeping tabs on your Range Bag.
